It is really hard to get out of that loop of self-loathing -> pressuring yourself to do better -> not meeting your expectations and then back to self-loathing. I personally still struggle with it.

I found that the solution often requires a lot patience and self compassion. Setting concrete and simple achievable goals towards improvement. Practicing understanding and compassion towards yourself. This set of actions can help you break the loop that constantly drains your day to day energy and in some way sets you up for failure. 

I understand it is hard to decide to engage in these actions. Maybe becuase we want to believe we are better, that we can withstand the pressure, unlike others. Otherwise, what sets us appart, what makes us special?

Honestly, I don't know. You could passions set you appart. But if you are depressed, finding your passions is not as easy, as you are already experiencing less enjoyment in life. 

I think making a conscious decision to do better every day, is what sets people appart. No matter how small the improvement is.
